headline: A rebuilt Shima
summary: The same island, rebuilt from the ground up: every alert, every gesture and every palette, with a cleaner setup.

changes.text: The island is drawn by its own view, so the collapsed capsule and the open card share the same shape.
Live updates from timers, rides and deliveries, read from on-going notifications.
The app row holds up to 10 apps and every card can be tuned part by part.
Backups are a plain JSON file you can read, edit and put back on another phone.
The camera cutout is measured on every screen edge and orientation, including the inner screen of a foldable.

headline: More control
summary: Rules, cards and a companion pill.

changes.text: Rules: one gesture can do different things depending on what the phone is doing.
A companion pill that sits next to the island.
Every card can be assembled part by part.

headline: New alert, new looks
summary: An alert for uninstalled apps, more ways to style the island, and lots of fixes.

changes.text: New alert: see which app you just uninstalled.
New alert: see your screenshot on the island the moment you take it, with Share, Copy, Edit and Delete.
Style the collapsed and expanded island separately. Set the transparency, outline and shadow for each.
You can now swipe up on the expanded island to close it. You can choose how cards close in each alert's settings.
Works on foldables: the island now shows on the inner screen of phones like the Galaxy Z Fold8.
Update without leaving the app. New versions download in the background, then tap Restart to install.
See what's new automatically after each update.
The App row now holds up to 10 apps. Swipe sideways to see the rest.
Swipe between tabs in alert settings, and between categories when picking an action.
Smoother right after you install or update the app.
Fixed an empty card showing after rotating the phone with a card open.
Fixed a small stutter when opening your music app from the music card.
Fixed alerts keeping their old colours after you changed or restored a palette.
Fixed the tab bar flashing when opening the app from its notification.

headline: The first island
summary: A capsule over the status bar that answers to what the phone is doing, and four tabs to make it yours.

changes.text: The island rests as the camera and widens for music, charging, the torch, volume and the mic and camera indicators.
Tap the island to expand it into a card for whatever it is carrying, with the transport controls on the music one.
Position & geometry calibrates the island against your phone's real cutout, per screen edge and per orientation.
Gestures: assign a tap, a long press or a swipe to an app, a widget or a card of your own.
Seven palettes, light and dark, and Material You if you would rather the island followed your wallpaper.
